children: Battery maker T1 Energy said Evan Calio, currently chief financial officer, was named to the additional position of president of the company, effective Nov. 12.

Calio has been CFO since June 2024, the company said. Prior to joining T1, Calio served as a managing director within energy and infrastructure investment banking at BTIG, and spent 14 years at Morgan Stanley, most recently as a managing director within Equity Research. Calio also worked in the energy investment banking division at Morgan Stanley and the energy proprietary trading business at JP Morgan, T1 said.
Also effective Nov. 12, Jaime Gualy, the company's current chief operating officer, transitioned to chief commercial officer, T1 Energy said.
